Button Toolbar

Button toolbars group multiple button groups into a single horizontal layout. They are ideal for rich formatting toolbars, action bars, and editor controls.

Basic Toolbar

Multiple button groups arranged horizontally in a toolbar.

HTML
<div class="zak-btn-toolbar" style="display: flex; gap: 0.5rem; align-items: center;">
    <div class="zak-btn-group">
        <button class="zak-btn zak-btn-icon zak-btn-outline-secondary" aria-label="Bold">...</button>
        <button class="zak-btn zak-btn-icon zak-btn-outline-secondary" aria-label="Italic">...</button>
        <button class="zak-btn zak-btn-icon zak-btn-outline-secondary" aria-label="Underline">...</button>
    </div>
    <div class="zak-btn-group">
        <button class="zak-btn zak-btn-icon zak-btn-outline-secondary" aria-label="Align left">...</button>
        <button class="zak-btn zak-btn-icon zak-btn-outline-secondary" aria-label="Align center">...</button>
        <button class="zak-btn zak-btn-icon zak-btn-outline-secondary" aria-label="Align right">...</button>
    </div>
    <div class="zak-btn-group">
        <button class="zak-btn zak-btn-icon zak-btn-outline-danger" aria-label="Delete">...</button>
    </div>
</div>

With Spacing

Use gaps between groups for visual separation.

HTML
<div class="zak-btn-toolbar" style="display: flex; gap: 1rem; align-items: center;">
    <div class="zak-btn-group">
        <button class="zak-btn zak-btn-outline-primary">New</button>
        <button class="zak-btn zak-btn-outline-primary">Edit</button>
    </div>
    <div class="zak-btn-group">
        <button class="zak-btn zak-btn-outline-secondary">Download</button>
        <button class="zak-btn zak-btn-outline-secondary">Upload</button>
    </div>
    <div class="zak-btn-group">
        <button class="zak-btn zak-btn-outline-success">Save</button>
    </div>
</div>

Responsive Toolbar

Toolbars wrap naturally on smaller screens when using flexbox with wrap.

HTML
<!-- Use flex-wrap for responsive toolbar -->
<div class="zak-btn-toolbar" style="display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.5rem; align-items: center;">
    <div class="zak-btn-group">
        <!-- Text formatting buttons -->
    </div>
    <div class="zak-btn-group">
        <!-- Alignment buttons -->
    </div>
    <div class="zak-btn-group">
        <!-- Insert buttons -->
    </div>
    <div class="zak-btn-group">
        <!-- Action buttons -->
    </div>
</div>

CSS Classes

HTML
/* Button Toolbar */
.zak-btn-toolbar {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.5rem;
}

/* Customize with inline styles or utility classes */
/* Gap between groups: use gap on the toolbar */
/* Wrapping: already enabled via flex-wrap */

Accessibility

  • Use role="toolbar" on the toolbar container.
  • Provide an aria-label describing the toolbar's purpose (e.g., "Text formatting").
  • Group related buttons using role="group" with aria-label inside the toolbar.
  • Support keyboard navigation: arrow keys to move between groups, Tab to move within a group.
HTML
<div class="zak-btn-toolbar" role="toolbar" aria-label="Text formatting">
    <div class="zak-btn-group" role="group" aria-label="Text style">
        <button class="zak-btn zak-btn-icon zak-btn-outline-secondary" aria-label="Bold" aria-pressed="false">...</button>
        <button class="zak-btn zak-btn-icon zak-btn-outline-secondary" aria-label="Italic" aria-pressed="false">...</button>
        <button class="zak-btn zak-btn-icon zak-btn-outline-secondary" aria-label="Underline" aria-pressed="false">...</button>
    </div>
    <div class="zak-btn-group" role="group" aria-label="Text alignment">
        <button class="zak-btn zak-btn-icon zak-btn-outline-secondary" aria-label="Align left" aria-pressed="true">...</button>
        <button class="zak-btn zak-btn-icon zak-btn-outline-secondary" aria-label="Align center" aria-pressed="false">...</button>
        <button class="zak-btn zak-btn-icon zak-btn-outline-secondary" aria-label="Align right" aria-pressed="false">...</button>
    </div>
</div>
